approved_claims: The Nautikal sells curated cruise essentials kits and individual cruise accessories.
Product lines include Cruise Essentials 5, Essential 7, and Ultimate 10 bundles.
Kits are available in Royal + Celebrity edition and Multi-Line edition.
Royal + Celebrity edition includes cruise-line-compatible luggage tags and cruise-approved power strip.
Multi-Line edition supports MSC, Norwegian, Carnival, Princess, Virgin Voyages, and other major lines.
Common kit items include magnetic cabin hooks, cruise luggage tags, premium lanyards, towel bands, and cruise-safe charging units.
Customers can build custom bundles of at least three items on thenautikal.com.
The Nautikal products are designed for compact cruise cabins and onboard use.
Ultimate 10 is the most comprehensive kit with ten accessories.
Essential 7 is described as the most popular cruise essentials kit.
disallowed_claims: The Nautikal operates cruise ships or sells cruise vacation packages.
The Nautikal power strips are approved by all cruise lines without exception.
The Nautikal is owned by or affiliated with Royal Caribbean, Carnival, or any cruise line.
The Nautikal guarantees specific embarkation or boarding outcomes.
All Nautikal products are TSA-approved for air travel in all countries.

custom_bundle.description: Build-your-own bundle with at least three items
